# se.hadi — Hadi Moustafa

> Software engineer and digital marketer based in Lebanon, working remotely worldwide. "I build it. I market it. I fix it. I grow it." Four services: engineering (web apps, e-commerce, management systems, financial trackers), marketing (paid ads, growth strategy, content), support (onboarding, maintenance, troubleshooting) and growth (social strategy, content creation, community management). Projects from $120. Replies to inquiries within 24 hours.
